QLFilePreviewRequest.doc: A Quick Look preview request that indicates the content to preview.

QLPreviewPanel.doc: A class that implements the Quick Look preview panel to display a preview of a list of items.

QLPreviewProvider.doc: A class that you subclass to provide a data-based Quick Look preview extension.

QLPreviewReply.doc: The class you create when providing a data-based Quick Look preview extension.

QLPreviewReplyAttachment.doc: An attachment for a Quick Look preview reply that provides additional content for the system to display a preview.

QLPreviewView.doc: A Quick Look preview of an item that you can embed into your view hierarchy.

QLPreviewItem.doc: A protocol that defines a set of properties you implement to make a preview of your application’s content.

QLPreviewPanelDataSource.doc: A protocol that the Quick Look preview panel uses to access the contents of its data source object.

QLPreviewPanelDelegate.doc: A protocol for the delegate of the Quick Look preview panel.

QLPreviewingController.doc: A protocol for implementing a custom controller to create previews of files.

QLPreviewViewStyleCompact.doc: Provides a compact preview style suited for smaller previews or inspectors.

QLPreviewViewStyleNormal.doc: Provides the default preview style for larger, full-sized previews.

+sharedPreviewPanel.doc: Returns the shared Quick Look preview panel instance.

+sharedPreviewPanelExists.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the system has created a shared Quick Look preview panel.

-enterFullScreenMode:withOptions:.doc: Instructs the panel to enter full screen mode.

-exitFullScreenModeWithOptions:.doc: Instructs the panel to exit full screen mode.

-refreshCurrentPreviewItem.doc: Asks the preview panel to recompute the preview of the current preview item.

-reloadData.doc: Asks the preview panel to reload its data from its data source.

-updateController.doc: Asks the preview panel to update its current controller.

-initWithFileURL:.doc: Creates a preview reply from an existing file URL.

-initWithData:contentType:.doc: Creates a preview reply attachment with the specified type.

-close.doc: Closes the view, releasing the current preview item.

-initWithFrame:.doc: Creates a preview view with the provided frame.

-initWithFrame:style:.doc: Creates a preview view with the provided frame and style.

-refreshPreviewItem.doc: Updates the preview to display the currently previewed item.

fileURL.doc: The URL that indicates the content to preview.

currentController.doc: The current first responder accepting to control the preview panel.

currentPreviewItemIndex.doc: The index of the current preview item.

delegate.doc: The delegate object that controls the preview panel’s behavior.

inFullScreenMode.doc: The property that indicates whether the panel is in full screen mode.

attachments.doc: The attachments for a preview reply that provide additional data for the system to display the preview.

stringEncoding.doc: String encoding for text or html based previews. Defaults to NSUTF8StringEncoding.

title.doc: The title for the system to display with the preview.

contentType.doc: The content type of the preview attachment.

data.doc: The data of the preview attachment.

autostarts.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the preview starts automatically.

displayState.doc: The current display state of the previewItem.

shouldCloseWithWindow.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the preview should close when its window closes.
